sentences.en: Have you ever thought about taking up a new hobby?
sentences.ko: 새로운 취미를 시작해 볼 생각을 해 본 적 있어요?

sentences.en: You really went out of your way to help me out.
sentences.ko: 당신은 정말 수고를 아끼지 않고 저를 도와주었어요.

sentences.en: I'm really into hiking these days—it really clears my head.
sentences.ko: 요즘 하이킹에 푹 빠져 있어요. 머리가 진짜 맑아지거든요.

sentences.en: I didn't mean to come across as rude—I was just tired.
sentences.ko: 무례하게 보이려던 건 아니었어요. 그냥 피곤했을 뿐이에요.

sentences.en: Your kind words mean the world to me—thank you.
sentences.ko: 당신의 다정한 말이 저에게 정말 큰 의미예요. 감사해요.
